note: Traced on Esri World Imagery (Vantor Vivid Premium, captured 2026-01-10, 0.34 m source pixels) from images resampled into the map frame. s = metres along the road (map frame), d = metres from the map centreline, + west. Reading error about +/-1 m. Esri, OpenStreetMap crossings and the USGS 3DEP lidar bridge abutments agree within about 1 m. Approved by Mark 2026-10-26.
